schedule_rule: For each stream in the original specification order, draw integer departures uniformly from [max(0, original-15, previous+1), min(899, original+15)] using random.Random(seed). Preserve IDs, OD, vehicle attributes and strict within-stream order. Original schedule is copied byte-for-byte.
offset_rule: Additional tlLogic with the same id/programID and offset=(original+extra)%90, without phase definitions.
classification: Descriptive deterministic sensitivity, no population confidence intervals or real traffic predictions.
